note: XXVI fills A: the night train, the trances, Galatz (29–30 Oct 1893, waning moon) · Booth style
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, light breaking through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. Cool late-autumn light by day, no golden glow. Any face is small and unreadable. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. Night of 29 October 1893: a steam train with lit carriage windows crossing the flat Wallachian plain toward Galatz, a plume of smoke silver in the light of a bright waning moon, two-thirds full, low in the east.

Shot: wide interior, no faces. A first-class railway compartment at night in 1893, its oil lamp turned low, a tea basket and cups on the seat, coats and rugs, the dark plain and the moon passing the window.

Shot: close, no people. Night: a thick hawser running from the dark side of a wooden ship to a bollard on a quay, black water swirling softly around the hull, a lantern far off, moonlight on the ripples.

Shot: very wide. A railway station platform in Bucharest at night in 1893: a great iron-and-glass train shed, gas lamps, a train standing with steam, a few travellers and porters small below, the big station clock.
Shot: very wide. Night in the Carpathian foothills: wolves small on a rocky ridge howling at a bright waning moon, a waterfall falling white below, dark forest, mountains beyond.

Shot: very wide. Dawn on 30 October 1893 on the low marshy bank of a broad Romanian river: mist on the water, cattle standing small in the reeds, a wooden ship sliding past in the mist, pale grey sky lightening.

Shot: very wide. The river port of Galatz, Romania, on a grey October morning in 1893: a broad street of tall plastered houses stepping down to the Danube, church domes, carts and a carriage, masts and funnels of steamers beyond.

Shot: establishing, very wide. The wharves of Galatz on the Danube on a grey October morning in 1893: a three-masted sailing ship moored at the quay, lighters, barrels and crates, porters small below, warehouses, the wide brown river.
Shot: far. The doorway of a shipping agents' office in Galatz in 1893, a brass plate beside it, three Englishmen in dark coats going in, small, a carriage waiting, morning light on the plaster.

Shot: far. A large wooden box being swung ashore by a creaking crane from a sailing ship onto the quay at Galatz, a man in a long dark coat and fur cap waiting with papers, small, grey morning, the river behind.

Shot: far. A long wooden cart drawn by horses leaving the Galatz quay with a great box on it, three Slovak carriers in big hats and sheepskin coats walking beside it, small, along a road under tall poplars.
